text:
emily: FYI customer 'skyline-ai' says our billed embed total for 2025-07-14 is ~7.9k lower than their client logs. Can someone confirm quickly?

billing-bot: automated alert: reconcile-delta detected for customer skyline-ai 2025-07-14 delta -7.9% (7,894 embeds). Ticket FIN-5180 opened.

kevin-sdk: tagging inwe shipped SDK 2.2.0 with a header compression change that truncates X-Client-Req-Id at 16 chars. Our ingest dedupe expects full id; truncation caused cross-request collisions for clients that used sequential ids.
omar: ledger quick-check: billed 92,006 embeds vs expected ~99,900. Delta ~7,894 embeds in windows 08:40-09:05 UTC and 18:12-18:28 UTC. Raw events show many identical truncated ids.
julia-finance: finance view: amount estimate 7,894 * $0.00045 = $3.55. Policy: vendor-caused undercounts -> issue credit + remediation. Please confirm patch plan.

kevin-sdk: patch ready: revert header truncation and publish SDK 2.2.1. We'll also add X-SDK-Version and preserve full client id by default.
omar: safer to credit now and run a sandbox replay. If replay confirms unique events we can add a metrics-only backfill but keep invoices unchanged.
julia-finance: agree. I'll file credit FIN-5181 for $3.55 and add invoice memo: "Credit for embed undercount due to SDK header truncation (2025-07-14)."
emily: please also add a note to the customer explaining the fix and include the replay report when ready.
kevin-sdk: publishing 2.2.1 now and posting release note in #devex.
omar: kicking off sandbox replay and saving artifacts to s3://forensics/skyline/2025-07-14-replay.tar.gz. Early run shows ~7,900 recoverable events with dedupe-override.
julia-finance: credit FIN-5181 applied and account notified. Closing finance loop.
emily: thanks all  will schedule a postmortem and a runbook update to avoid header-truncation regressions. Closing thread.
